selection_rules.exact: Exact-root matching is impossible until a primary-source-backed theorem branch and exact Lean proposition are frozen. No slogan, parameterized predicate shape, or single branch chosen by the auditor can be called exact.
selection_rules.supporting: Scheme, rational-map, properness, integral/noetherian, sites, and module-sheaf APIs are classified independently as support only.
selection_rules.placeholder: Prop-valued stand-ins for terminal singularities, Q-factoriality, canonical divisors, minimal models, or Mori fibre spaces are statement-shape metadata, never proof bodies.
selection_rules.negative_evidence: Each lane records its exact tracked or pinned source, revision or content hash, access boundary, and reopen condition. An access failure is not interpreted as a zero-result search.
selection_rules.deduplication: The legacy StatementShape and ExplicitFieldStatementShape share one programme-level interface origin and receive no duplicate proof credit.

credentials_policy: No credentials are available to this offline worker. The archived unauthenticated GitHub repository results may be replayed from immutable tracked bytes; archived 401 and timeout rows remain access failures.
expected_negative_result_evidence: Tracked source SHA-256 and Git blob, pinned package revision/tree and source blobs, or a content-bound archived response/access-failure row with date and query.
network_policy: denied for worker replay; no clone, fetch, update, dependency build, or moving-ref query is part of this inventory version
immutable_refresh_policy: A selected exact statement, new immutable Lean candidate, changed dependency pin, authenticated search archive, or primary-source selection creates an append-only inventory version and invalidates this one.
